run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T09:53:52Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend-proxy RequestErrorRate alert is firing on a sustained elevation of errors recorded by frontend-proxy itself. Over the 84-minute window its 'ingress' spans carried 516.1 ERROR spans and 'router frontend egress' 490.7 ERROR spans, and the error rate steps from ~0.011-0.015/s (ingress-only) to ~1.0-1.23/s at about 10:00, at which point ingress and egress errors move in lockstep. The egress side proves the errors come from the upstream it proxies: frontend. On the frontend side, the error rate of 'GET /api/data' is step-for-step identical to the error rate of its client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (and to frontend 'GET'), and the matching server-side span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' in the ad service is also ERROR at the same count (~88% of GetAds spans errored at 10:14). frontend-proxy's own access log shows the same requests as 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=... 500 - via_upstream' starting 09:59:40, and the ad container logs show repeated uncaught-handler gRPC exception lines from ~10:00:26. So the supported causal chain is: ad service GetAds handler throws -> frontend /api/data returns 500 -> frontend-proxy ingress spans are ERROR -> RequestErrorRate fires. Why the ad handler throws is not established: the ad container logs contain no stack trace or message, no flag/GC/OOM line, and flagd's runtime flag state cannot be read (the flagd-config ConfigMap only holds defaults, incl. adFailure defaultVariant 'off'). Resource-saturation and flagd-outage explanations are contradicted by low ad CPU (~0.005-0.021 cores), memory that plateaus with no restart/OOM, GetAds latencies under 1 s, and zero error spans on flag-evaluation RPCs. A separate, earlier population of ingress-only 503 UC upstream_reset errors (09:41-09:59) is not tied to ad and may be what started the alert at 09:53:52; that and the alert's reported 'current: 2.111' cannot be reconciled because no RequestErrorRate rule is loaded in the queried Prometheus.

claims.text: In the default window 08:53:52-10:17:59Z, frontend-proxy had 516.06 ERROR spans on span_name 'ingress' (plus 23221.84 STATUS_CODE_UNSET) and 490.67 ERROR spans on span_name 'router frontend egress' (plus 23247.24 STATUS_CODE_UNSET).

frontend-proxy's 5m error rate held at ~0.011-0.015/s on 'ingress' until 10:00 and then climbed to 0.18 -> 1.00/s; 'router frontend egress' error rate was exactly 0 until the same step and then rose to ~0.99/s, i.e. proxy ingress errors became mirrored by upstream (frontend) egress errors.

In the 09:45-10:17Z window the non-zero error-span increases were: frontend-proxy 'ingress' 512.5 and 'router frontend egress' 495.1; frontend 'GET', 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 492.0-493.4; ad 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 473.6; plus small flagd EventStream counts on ad 2.05, fraud-detection 3.07 and recommendation 2.05. Zero error increases were returned for ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean', accounting 'orders receive', payment spans and frontend cart/checkout spans.

For every 2-minute step from 10:02 to 10:11, frontend's 'GET', 'GET /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' spans show identical ERROR rates (e.g. 1.2333/s at 10:08 and 10:10) and identical UNSET rates (0.0689-0.2111/s), i.e. each /api/data request is errored exactly when its GetAds call is errored.

At 10:14Z (10m rate) the two ends of the same GetAds calls are both marked error: frontend client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' ERROR 0.5628/s and UNSET 0.0738/s; ad service span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' ERROR 0.5609/s and UNSET 0.0738/s, i.e. ~88% of GetAds spans were ERROR.

frontend-proxy access logs show 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=...' answered '500 - via_upstream' starting at 09:59:40.752, 09:59:41.102, 09:59:43.720 and 09:59:44.037 (client is python-requests/2.32.5 via frontend-proxy:8080, upstream frontend).

Before the 500s, the same frontend-proxy access log shows a different, low-rate error pattern: '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on GET /api/products/*, /api/cart and /api/recommendations at 09:41:26, 09:43:52, 09:44:53, 09:45:08, 09:53:34, 09:53:40 (twice), 09:56:03, 09:58:32 (three) and 09:59:05.
In the pre-surge 30-minute bucket ending 10:00Z, frontend-proxy recorded 16.33 error spans, ad 1.03 and frontend 0, i.e. the proxy-only error population was ~0.009/s.

The ad container repeatedly logs 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@...' interleaved with normal 'Targeted ad request received for [...]' lines: already present at 10:00:26.911, then 10:00:36.067, 10:01:08.166, 10:02:50.236 ... 10:03:18.49, and continuing through 10:08:46. No stack trace, exception class or message accompanies these lines.
ad pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg CPU usage rate stayed between 0.0052 and 0.021 cores from 09:38 to 10:10, i.e. no CPU saturation at the time of the failures.

ad 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' span durations stayed short during the failures: 10:04-10:14 had 380.8 calls with 313.3 at <=100ms and all at <=1000ms (baseline 09:40-09:50: 551.6 calls, 510.5 at <=100ms, all <=1000ms), so no seconds-scale timeout/deadline behaviour.

ad container working-set memory rose from 647,426,048 bytes at 09:40 to 731,226,112 bytes and stayed flat at that value for 10:11, 10:13 and 10:14; the pod shows 0 restarts, ready=true and no terminated/previous container state.

All 21 pods in namespace otel-demo are Running and ready with restart count 0, started 09:23:36-09:25:30Z; the ad pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg is owned by deployment ad via ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 created 09:23:36Z, and all deployments show 1/1 available with the demo:2.1.3-* images, i.e. no rollout or pod replacement during the incident window.

The flagd-config ConfigMap declares flag 'adFailure' (description 'Fail ad service') with defaultVariant 'off', state ENABLED and variants off/on, alongside adHighCpu and adManualGc with defaultVariant 'off'; this is static file content, not proof of flagd's runtime flag values.

A sampled trace view of frontend-proxy in 09:37:57-09:37:58Z shows normal traffic: ingress and router frontend egress spans with http.status_code 200, frontend /api/cart 200 and cart grpc status 0 (5 traces, 36 spans, 0 error rows) - a sample of that instant only.

The elevated frontend-proxy ingress error rate is caused by failures returned by the ad service's GetAds handler: ad-side 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' server spans are ERROR in the same counts as the frontend's client GetAds spans, frontend's 'GET /api/data' is ERROR at exactly that rate, and frontend-proxy access logs show those requests as '500 - via_upstream' from frontend. Direction of causality is inferred from the client/server span pairing and the 500-on-/api/data log lines, not from an unbroken trace (Jaeger has no data after 09:37:58Z).

The ad handler exceptions are consistent with a runtime-enabled failure-injection flag such as flagd flag 'adFailure' (declared in flagd-config as 'Fail ad service'): an application-thrown gRPC handler exception with no CPU, memory, restart or latency pressure is the signature of the demo's ad-failure scenario. This is not verified - flagd's live flag values are not readable and the ad log lines carry no flag name or exception message; the observed ~88% (not 100%) GetAds error share is also not fully explained by a boolean on/off flag.

The alert's own start time (09:53:52Z, before the /api/data 500 surge at ~09:59:40) may have been triggered by the separate, low-rate Envoy '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' population on /api/products/*, /api/cart and /api/recommendations (including two such 503s at 09:53:34 and 09:53:40). That population has no matching frontend error spans and is not shown to be caused by ad; what resets those upstream connections is unresolved.
ad CPU (0.0052-0.021 cores) and total GetAds latency (all spans <=1000ms, 82% <=100ms in 10:04-10:14) do not support CPU saturation, throttling or timeout/deadline explanations for the GetAds errors.

flagd itself shows no failure signal in the same window: ad's 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean' and fraud-detection's 'ResolveInt' had zero error spans, EventStream error counts were tiny (2.05 and 3.07 per 30 min), and the flagd pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts - so an unreachable/failing flagd is not supported by the available signals.

Rejected: ad pod crash/OOM/restart as the cause. All ad pod containers report ready=true, restartCount 0, no lastState.terminated reason, and memory working set plateaued at 731,226,112 bytes instead of hitting a limit - no Evicted/OOMKilled/BackOff marker was found.

Rejected: a deployment/rollout or pod replacement during the incident as the cause. The ad ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 was created 09:23:36Z (same time as its pod's startTime), every deployment reports 1/1 available with unchanged demo:2.1.3-* images, and no pod in otel-demo started later than 09:25:30Z - i.e. nothing was rolled out around the ~10:00 onset. Change history is not integrated, so a change outside the K8s objects cannot be excluded.

Rejected: CPU-load chaos in ad (flag adHighCpu) as the cause. ad CPU stayed at 0.005-0.021 cores across 09:38-10:10 and GetAds durations stayed under 1 s, so neither CPU burn nor the latency inflation that would follow is visible.

Read flagd's live/runtime flag values (flagd-ui or flagd's flag API) for 'adFailure', 'adHighCpu' and 'adManualGc' around 09:59-10:00Z to test the feature-flag hypothesis; compare against the ConfigMap defaults that show 'off'.

Capture the thrown exception class/message and stack trace from the ad service (gRPC verbose logging or added logging around the GetAds handler) to name the exact failure reason instead of inferring it.

Review the RequestErrorRate alerting rule (expression, threshold, evaluation interval) in the Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration so the reported value 2.111 and the 09:53:52 start can be reconciled with the two observed error populations.

gaps: The alerting rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not present in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with type=alert both returned no_data, so the alert expression, threshold, evaluation interval and the meaning of 'current: 2.111' are unknown.

Jaeger's newest data is 2026-11-15T09:37:58.738Z (freshness ~2400-2500s at query time), so no spans exist for the ~10:00 error surge; the ad span's status description/code and the frontend 500 status message could not be read, and no end-to-end trace of a failed /api/data request is available.

The ad container's exception lines contain no class, message or stack trace, and no log line mentions a feature flag, GC, OOM or heap event; therefore the specific reason the GetAds handler throws is unknown.

flagd's runtime flag values are not readable with the available tools (only the static flagd-config ConfigMap was read; secrets are not readable and no flagd API is exposed), so an enabled adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc flag cannot be confirmed or excluded.

frontend pod logs returned no lines for 09:58-10:15Z (0 bytes read), so the frontend-side error text for the /api/data 500s is unknown; frontend-proxy logs were likewise unreadable for 10:10-10:11Z (0 bytes) and the 09:40-10:15Z read stopped at the 4 MiB limit at 09:59:44Z.

Trace metrics only exist from ~09:30-09:36Z, so it cannot be determined whether the low-rate Envoy 503 UC errors or earlier ad/GetAds error bursts existed before that, i.e. no long baseline for the error rate is available.

Kubernetes events returned nothing for the authorized window and only current object state was observable (no historical state), and the change_history integration is not integrated, so any out-of-band configuration change cannot be verified.

The http_server_request_duration_seconds_count metric listed as available returned no series in 09:45-10:17Z, so frontend-proxy's own HTTP status error ratio could not be computed; error classification relies on traces_span_metrics_calls_total plus Envoy access logs.

No metric or log evidence was inspected for cart, checkout, product-catalog, recommendation, currency, shipping, email, kafka, quote, image-provider, accounting or load-generator beyond the absence of non-zero error-span increases in traces_span_metrics_calls_total; those services are unchecked, not proven healthy.
next_steps: Inspect flagd's runtime flag state (flagd-ui / flagd flags API) for adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc at 09:55-10:15Z.
If the ad-failure flag is confirmed on, record it as the trigger and verify whether other demo failure flags were toggled at the same time.
If no flag is on, collect ad service stack traces and JVM/GC diagnostics for the GetAds handler exceptions.

Reconcile the RequestErrorRate rule and its 2.111 value with the two proxy error populations, and decide whether the 503 UC upstream_reset errors on /api/products, /api/cart and /api/recommendations need their own investigation (frontend reset vs. load-generator cancellation).
Restore Jaeger ingestion (stale since 09:37:58Z) and frontend/frontend-proxy log collection so future incidents have complete traces and logs.
